newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Front-month Brent trades under $20.00 on SIMEX.
newsitem.headline: Front-month Brent trades under $20.00 on SIMEX.

text.p: April Brent crude oil futures traded at $19.98 per barrel on the Singapore International Monetary Exchange (SIMEX) on Friday -- the lowest front-month price since August 29, 1996, traders said.
The modest trade of just 64 lots represented the first trade of the day on SIMEX on Friday.

Prices have been under pressure for several weeks on a mixture of technically-led selling and a perception that heating oil stocks in the United States were ample for the remainder of winter requirements.
In addition, the crude markets are increasingly focusing on the second quarter of the year when seasonal demand falls as temperatures in the northern hemisphere warm up.
The next line of support for the front-month was at $19.96, and then $19.87, chartists said.
April Brent fell 55 cents in London on Thursday to close at $20.08 amid expiry-related selling on NYMEX.
But brokers said the London close was weak -- just one cent above the intraday low -- indicating players had further appetite to exploit the downside.
By 0935 GMT, April was last traded on SIMEX at $19.99.
